text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That BNW showdown sure was heated after all~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket came in first,
but Narita Taishin was seriously amazing, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was so intense.
Was it always like that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, YESSSSSS!!!
I beat both of theeeem!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Taishin's running was amazing.
For a moment, I thought I might actually lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (...What if this had been the Derby?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Urk, waaaahhhhh~~!!
No backing down! Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Isn't it like this all the time?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Still... I cannot afford to yield the next race, of all things. I must prepare thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to thoroughly analyze today's share.
The tickets... and yours, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, the heated race shown by BNW
earned massive acclaim—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The number of fans longing to see them
clash on the track once more skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the one Winning Ticket has her heart set on:
the Japanese Derby...!
